captions.detailed: A desk-clamp gooseneck LED lamp featuring a dark gray C-clamp base with a silver screw mechanism. The main arm consists of three curved gray links connected by dark gray joint blocks. At the end of the final link is a circular, puck-shaped LED light head with a light-colored diffusing lens. Each joint in the three-link arm articulates via a revolute joint, and the LED puck rotates on a revolute joint at the tip.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated desk-clamp gooseneck lamp. It should feature a C-clamp base with a screw lever, a three-link segmented arm using curved segments, and a circular LED puck light at the end. Make sure to define revolute joints between each arm segment and at the connection to the lamp head, using dark gray and light gray colors.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by defining several parts. It begins with a base clamp constructed from Box and Cylinder primitives to form the C-clamp and its screw handle. It then defines three arm links, each utilizing a curved geometry (modeled via a swept or bent Cylinder/Box representation) and connecting blocks. The final part is the LED lamp head, modeled as a flat Cylinder puck. Revolute joints are declared between the clamp and the first link, between successive arm links, and between the final link and the lamp head.
